diagnostics.falsifiable_readout: Few both-informative queries bounds the scope of any coupling signal. One-informative strata must have equal J_K/J_K_sep losses and gradients under the fixed numeric rule; discrepancy signals implementation, not a new mechanism.
diagnostics.name: Exact exposure census
diagnostics.record: At every actual full batch, separate positive/negative queries and count n_L,k_L,n_R,k_R; zero/one/two informative sides; empty/extreme strata; duplicate multiplicity/query-edge survival; support/teacher/stream hashes. Report all-query totals and actual denominator-weighted exposure without informative-only training renormalization.

diagnostics.falsifiable_readout: Gap inconsistent with the identity is a source/numeric defect. Zero or adverse gain on future prereleased TRAIN-mask contexts contradicts a useful local pairing hypothesis; positive TRAIN fit alone does not identify graph coherence.
diagnostics.name: Same-state paired-law gap
diagnostics.record: From exactly the same logits/context/teacher compute J_K,J_K_sep,W_K, uniform fixed-count NLL [log binom(n_L,k_L)+log binom(n_R,k_R)]/d, r_L,r_R,r_J and -log(M dot(r_L,r_R))/d. Retain both-informative strata and loss-weighted signed gaps; keep all-query means.

diagnostics.falsifiable_readout: Uniform responsibilities can coexist with nonzero informative gradients. Low-use members with tiny gradients indicate starvation; zero-signal query prevalence can explain reduced auxiliary strength despite coefficient1. Collapse with no benefit over matched controls defeats a specialization reading.
diagnostics.name: Responsibility versus gradient competence
diagnostics.record: Record side/joint responsibility entropy/effective use and actual component/shared parameter auxiliary-gradient norms; compare target/auxiliary norm and direction, zero-sum per-side logit gradients, and planned one-informative equality. Use fixed admission/tolerances; no probe enters optimization or RNG stream.

diagnostics.falsifiable_readout: If results are unaffected by relative pairing, observed coupling is unidentifiable on that probe. If the original pairing differs, this establishes local association only. Treating mean shuffled loss as J_K_sep is false.
diagnostics.name: Permutation falsification at fixed logits
diagnostics.record: Keep fitted state/logits fixed. Verify common-permutation J_K invariance and independent-permutation J_K_sep invariance. For M4, the24 relative pairings may be reported as a passive exact likelihood calculation; their uniform probability mean equals q_sep. Report the separate mean shuffled NLL and Jensen gap. Never choose a favorable permutation or permute members during fitting.

diagnostics.falsifiable_readout: A same-state law gap separates association from changed learned marginals. End-fit gain concentrated in marginal quality or smaller gradients weakens a coupling-only explanation. These probes do not select checkpoints.
diagnostics.name: Cross-score both fitted states
diagnostics.record: At prereleased checkpoints or the already fixed selected states of J_K and J_K_sep, score both local laws on the identical TRAIN probe contexts and count strata; report whole-side mixture NLL and conditional unary positive/zero competence. Retain the2x2 fitted-state versus scored-law table.

diagnostics.falsifiable_readout: Coupling restricted to a masking/multiplicity stratum supports only that restricted source regime. Mask dependence is not a graph-level latent cause. Any alternative mask intervention or synthetic null needs a separate prospective source/release and must not alter the current frozen stream.
diagnostics.name: Mask and record-construction accounting
diagnostics.record: Bind each hidden counterpart edge to unique-edge multiplicity and selected-record visibility status; distinguish full-TRAIN wedges/positive-query triangles, visible common slots, absent support and retained duplicate query edges. Stratify by degrees/support sizes, multiplicity, both counts and positive/negative query type; count shared endpoints/edges across probe queries.

diagnostics.falsifiable_readout: Qualified S_K parity defeats bank necessity in this regime. S_K failure alone is not necessity evidence, because finite features/head/target capacity and budgets differ. A count-only potential is not this control.
diagnostics.name: Capable single parity and limits
diagnostics.record: After separate native/full-batch S_K qualification, preserve its fixed order/context/initialization, exact all-slot schedule and costs. Compare matching-side capability, fixed-count identity NLL versus uniform baseline, positive/zero competence and complete count-free served ranking on the same declared evaluation/selector. Record prefix feature collisions and endpoint-order convention.

diagnostics.falsifiable_readout: Conditional-only improvement fails the useful-ranking hypothesis. Better ranking requires the fixed named controls and separate replication before generalization claims. Counts or uniform-prior entropy alone do not demonstrate arrangement competence.
diagnostics.name: Source identity versus served benefit
diagnostics.record: Retain old J_P count and conditional-identity terms using its count-evidence posterior member weights, native target losses and official complete VALID ranking/selected replay beside conditional diagnostics. Use only the original selector; no diagnostic selection or consumed TEST.

measurement_contract: Preserve all native complete updates, all-query reduction, original selector, RNG/recipe and caps. Additional forward/gradient/arrangement probes need their own admitted source and pay their full cost. No diagnostics executed or current source modified.
sampling_limit: One graph; overlapping queries, shared batch masks and repeated edges are dependent. Report descriptive strata and graph/seed replication separately; do not count queries as independent graphs.
